name: Splinter Wisp
role: Add mob · summoned by Shield Phase (Hollow Sentinel, Shardmother) · beam attack
notes: Facing north (-Z). Origin at the ground under it; it floats with its core about 12 px (0.75 blocks) up. 1 grid square = 1 texture pixel = 1/16 block. Hitbox 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5 blocks around the core.
A single floating splinter shard: a bright violet crystal core with a glowing heart and three small chips orbiting it. No face; the beam starts from the core's front.
Bones (6): root > core > orbit > chip_1, chip_2, chip_3. The orbit bone spins so the chips circle the core; a projectile locator sits on the core front for the beam.

Animations: spawn (sparks gather into the shard), idle (slow spin, chips orbit, gentle bob), attack (core flares, beam to the target), hurt (flicker), death (shatters into sparks). While any Wisp lives, its boss's Shield Phase holds.
